# dagsterplus_github_integration (Resource)

Selects the active GitHub App installation for the Dagster+ organization. This is a singleton resource — one per organization. The GitHub App must already be installed via the GitHub OAuth flow before using this resource. Destroying this resource deselects (deactivates) the GitHub App installation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Select the active GitHub App installation for the organization.
# Pre-requisite: the GitHub App must already be installed via the GitHub OAuth
# flow in the Dagster+ UI before using this resource.
resource "dagsterplus_github_integration" "example" {
  account_name = "my-github-org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String) The GitHub account or organization name that has the app installed.

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) The GitHub App ID.
- `id` (String) Organization name (used as the resource identifier).
- `repos` (List of String) List of repositories accessible via the GitHub App installation.
- `settings_url` (String, Sensitive) URL to the GitHub App installation settings.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using the organization name as the ID.
terraform import dagsterplus_github_integration.example my-org
```
